notes.1: Many candidates were successful but there were a number who got as far as finding the critical values of 7 and –1 but then incorrectly stated x >7 and x > −1. Others had made earlier mistakes and had not arrived at the correct quadratic. Weaker candidates did not expand and collect terms but went straight to x−1>12 and x−5>12. Answer: x >7 or x <−1

notes.key_messages:
Candidates should remember that the word ‘hence’ is an indication that subsequent work on a question
needs to use what has just been established. Work which disregards this instruction will receive no credit.
notes.general_comments:
Candidates found a number of questions on this paper demanding. The particular questions were generally
those which required candidates to apply their knowledge to unfamiliar circumstances. The questions which
fell into this category were Questions 8, 11 and 12.
